id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying syncs that hit an invalid uuid value

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion error classification and recovery
review.reason: Adds PostgreSQL UUID parsing failure to warehouse ingestion error handling, distinguishing it from retryable errors and providing actionable remediation advice; includes regression tests. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk observations; no independent verification of production behavior or actual incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error entry for PostgreSQL UUID parsing failures and its friendly remediation message.
observations.posthog_connection: This extends the warehouse ingestion error classification to recognize PostgreSQL UUID parsing failures, allowing PostHog to distinguish these from retryable errors and provide users with actionable advice regarding row filters or foreign table casting.

observations.behavior: Adds test assertions and updates a test name to cover UUID parsing failures alongside timestamp failures.
observations.code_quote: 'InvalidTextRepresentation: invalid input syntax for type uuid: "not-a-uuid"',
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests and a renamed assertion to verify that UUID parsing failures are correctly classified as non-retryable errors, supporting the implementation change.
